sources.label: BDO Mexico MXNB Q2 2026 valuation report

reserveReview.rationale: BDO Mexico (Castillo Miranda y Compania) Q2 2026 financial valuation as of 30 June 2026 (published 2026-07-16, PDF read this pass): a single aggregate line 'Reserves on bank accounts' MXN 35,333,251.88 against MXN 34,828,276.31 of MXNB in circulation (surplus 504,975.57). The engagement is consultancy under IVSC standards, expressly does not confirm balances with banks, and restricts use to management; its scope paragraph still says 'as of March 31, 2026' (stale copy-paste). No bank names or instrument split are disclosed - composition stays one bank-deposit category at probable confidence.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BDO Mexico Q2 2026 valuation of MXNB reserve bank-account balances
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies Nvio and Hey Banco but does not disclose the balance at each institution, account terms, deposit protection, or direct bank confirmation. The issuer's current transparency page provides only aggregate reserves and circulation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The whitepaper states that reserves are legally and operationally segregated from issuer and affiliate operating funds and held through a single-purpose entity. It does not establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness, current provider shares, account-level allocations, or rehypothecation treatment.
